responsibility: Defines the analyzer module’s common public declarations and foundational utility types. It centralizes forward declarations for core graph, state, region, and symbolic-value classes; shared helpers for diagnostic formatting and call recognition; generic support types such as path_var, region_offset, custom_edge_info, path_context, and consolidation maps; and the external entry points used across the analyzer engine, models, and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the analyzer module’s common header, centralizing forward declarations, shared utility types, helper prototypes, and cross-component APIs. Unlike analyzer.cc it does not implement those helpers, and unlike analyzer.opt it is C++ interface code rather than option-generation metadata.
